---
name: security-review
description: Use when reviewing marketplace authentication, authorization, validation, sessions, secrets, uploads, webhooks, payments, dependencies, or abuse controls.
---

Identify assets, actors, trust boundaries, abuse cases, and impact. Verify server-side authorization, validation, output handling, session and secret controls, rate limits, upload/webhook/payment protections, auditability, and dependency risk. Record findings with severity, evidence, and remediation.

Critical security changes require explicit approval and a threat model.
